title: Usage Supplement Schedule for Residential Natural Gas Supply Sign-Up Credits
content:
**Schedule.** When a Residential Natural Gas Supply sign-up credit is posted, the usage supplement depends on the therms billed on all energy lines of the agreement since service start: 10.00 when they total 1500 or more, 5.00 when they total 750 or more but below 1500, and no supplement below 750. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the sign-up credit owed.

The usage counted is the total therms of every energy charge line on the agreement's bill ledger.

| Therms on all energy lines since service start | Usage supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 1500 or more | 10.00 |
| 750 to 1499 | 5.00 |
| below 750 | none |

### Worked case (hypothetical ledger)

Four energy lines of 210, 245, 180 and 140 therms total 775 therms, so the supplement is 5.00. With 740 therms in all, there is none.
